method: 内置image_gen；原件保留，图集由运行时分区读取与绑定。

prompts.torso: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached headless correspondent body. Create a TORSO-ONLY animation layer: remove BOTH COMPLETE ARMS, sleeves from shoulder joint outward, cuffs, hands. Keep collar, neck stump, both shoulder straps, chest panels, mint trim, orbital emblem, jacket torso, belt and upper trousers IDENTICAL. Reconstruct clean continuous side contours of sleeveless jacket torso hidden behind arms. Preserve exact original 1024x1536 framing and body coordinates: neck around x420..560,y335..425; shoulder span x200..820 at y520; belt y1140. Do not zoom/recenter. No head or hair, no remaining floating arm parts. All empty area outside torso genuinely transparent alpha, no backdrop/shadow. High quality anime original linework. This layer will have separate rigged arms attached later.
prompts.arms: Use case: stylized-concept. Input image is a costume reference ONLY. Make ONE production sprite ATLAS for rigging this original anime correspondent's arms. True transparent background. Landscape 1536x1024, a STRICT invisible 3 columns by 2 rows grid, each cell512x512; no lines or labels. Exactly ONE isolated part per cell, centered with ample transparent margin; NO torso/head, no floating duplicates. Same detailed anime shading and pale male skin, charcoal jacket sleeve, light gray armor/cuff panels, black wrist strap, mint edge, small brass buckle, matching reference. ALL PARTS oriented vertical, proximal attachment at TOP, distal end at BOTTOM. Top-left cell: upper arm sleeve ONLY from rounded shoulder cap to elbow, black folded fabric with small light-gray outer panel, rounded overlap at elbow, no forearm/hand. Top-middle: forearm sleeve ONLY elbow top to gray cuff bottom, rounded elbow overlap, black strap and mint cuff trim, no hand. Top-right: relaxed bare hand ONLY, wrist top, fingers down, palm-side, thumb to viewer left. Bottom-left: OPEN PALM hand ONLY, wrist top, five clearly separate fingers pointing down, palm facing viewer, thumb left. Bottom-middle: POINTING hand ONLY, wrist top, index extended downward, other fingers curled, thumb anatomically correct. Bottom-right: GRIP hand ONLY, wrist top, fingers curled gently as holding edge of a signboard, thumb visible. Same adult proportions across hand cells, clean silhouettes. Each sleeve part about350px tall and160px wide. Each hand about230px tall and150px wide. Opaque parts, transparent outside; no shadow or backdrop. Must be usable separate pieces for a two-bone arm rig.
prompts.expressions: Use case: identity-preserve. Reference image is the original isolated head of adult male correspondent C. Create ONE production EXPRESSION ATLAS, 1536x1024 landscape, strict invisible3columns x2rows, six512x512 cells. One EXACT FRONTAL HEAD per cell, identical identity, proportions, head placement, hair silhouette, earrings and mint streak in ALL six, eyes and eyebrows unobstructed enough. Each head fits entirely inside its cell with20px margin, head top y20, chin y440 relative to cell. No shoulders/body/neck/background. Detailed same anime linework. Genuine transparent alpha outside heads. Cell top-left: friendly SMILE with open eyes, gently curved closed lips. Top-middle: humorous SMIRK, one eyebrow lifted, crooked closed-mouth knowing smile. Top-right: THINKING, eyebrows slightly knit, eyes glancing up, closed lips. Bottom-left: SURPRISE, wide open eyes, raised brows, small open O mouth. Bottom-middle: RESIGNED deadpan, half-lidded eyes, subtly concerned eyebrows, closed straight lips. Bottom-right: ANGRY but restrained newsroom reaction, eyebrows angled down, focused eyes, closed displeased lips. Preserve original head FRONT geometry; do not turn heads, no hand gestures, no text/grid labels, no props, no comic symbols. Facial states will drive separate eye/brow/mouth regions, so matched landmarks and scale essential. Avoid six different people or chibi.
prompts.talk: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: six-head expression atlas. Change ONLY MOUTHS to corresponding speaking states, keeping all six heads, hair, eyes, eyebrows, nose, face contour, scale and exact1536x1024 grid positions unchanged. Top-left smile: open smiling mouth, small upper teeth and mouth cavity. Top-middle smirk: slightly open asymmetric amused mouth. Top-right thinking: small slightly open speaking mouth. Bottom-left surprise: preserve open O mouth. Bottom-middle resigned: small flat open mouth with subtle cavity. Bottom-right angry: slightly open tense mouth, tiny upper teeth. Preserve identity and skin tones and all head placement. Mouth centers approximately local x275 y415 in each512x512 cell. Do not zoom/recenter. Genuine transparent background outside heads, no labels/text/props. These will be lip animation patches registered with the closed-mouth atlas.
